events.title: St. Olaf falls at Stiklestad
events.shortBlurb: The king who worked to Christianize Norway was killed in battle and became the nation's patron…
body: Olaf Haraldsson, king of Norway, labored to unite his realm and to root the Christian faith firmly in the land, sometimes by forceful means that stirred the opposition of the great chieftains. Driven into exile, he returned to reclaim his kingdom and met his enemies in battle at Stiklestad.

There, on the twenty-ninth of July 1030, he was killed. Miracles were soon reported at his grave, and he was venerated as a martyr and saint; honored as Rex Perpetuus Norvegiae, the eternal king of Norway, he became the patron of the nation whose conversion he had advanced.
